scope.dataset: The source contains 12 logs recorded on one date in 2021.
scope.historical_supervision: All 12 logs were used in historical supervised development.
scope.generalization: LOSO/holdout here is retrospective; it does not establish untouched-data or unseen-date generalization.
scope.verdict: Descriptive comparison only; no automatic stage-pass decision.

aggregation.case_wilson95: Descriptive case-level Wilson 95% intervals; cases sharing a sequence are clustered, so these are not cluster-adjusted confidence intervals.
aggregation.sequence_bootstrap95: Deterministic percentile intervals of equally weighted paired sequence means; only whole sequences are resampled. This describes variation among available logs, not independent acquisition dates.
aggregation.effect_sign: deep minus comparator; negative RMSE/recovery changes favor deep, positive success changes favor deep.
aggregation.relative_error_delta: 100 * (deep / comparator - 1), paired finite values with comparator > 0; finite failed runs are included.
aggregation.stable_recovery: Method medians use successful cases only; paired differences use jointly successful cases only. Outage recovery time is measured from range resumption by the runner.
aggregation.success_definition: Use the runner's success flag: a terminal suffix of at least 5 seconds with position error at most 0.5 m throughout.
aggregation.timing: Elapsed replay times are descriptive and may include concurrent CPU contention; no speed claim is computed.
aggregation.missing_values: Unavailable/nonfinite numeric values become null and are counted; failures never receive a fabricated recovery time.

sequence_bootstrap95.weighting: equal sequence means; resample sequences only
